object.name: royal throne
object.description: An ornate royal throne chair in dark carved walnut wood and deep crimson velvet upholstery. It features a tall, arched backrest crowned with intricate gilded finials, tufted velvet seat and back cushions, wide scrolled armrests with carved lion-head accents, and sturdy turned legs. Rich, regal finish with subtle satin sheen on the woodwork and soft matte velvet.
